full_judgment: 5. The second contention of the petitioner before the High Court Division and also before us is that the suit is barred by limitation as it was filed after 15 years of the cause of action. The High Court Division rightly noticed paragraph 17 of the plaint in Which it was stated that the cause of action arose lastly after the judgment of the Appellate Division in the earlier suit on 4-2-91. The High Court Division rightly held that the plaint cannot be rejected after reading paragraph 17 of the plaint.
